We need DBE for C12H15ClO. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). No N. So treat Cl as H. So effective H = 15 + 1 (Cl) = 16? Actually halogen counts as hydrogen, so subtract halogen from H count? The formula: DBE = C - (H+X)/2 + N/2 +1, where X = halogens. So H+X = 15+1=16. So DBE = 12 - 16/2 + 0 +1 = 12 -8 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula to be safe.
